# Nagavardhan Lella

> B2B marketer running marketing for two AI platforms, AIQoD and VentureHub360, and building the sites, content, and campaigns that go with them.

Nagavardhan Lella is a B2B marketer with a background in operations who handles end-to-end marketing, positioning, demand generation, content, SEO, and full-stack website builds for enterprise AI software platforms.

- Role: B2B Marketer & Web Builder

## Capabilities & Specializations
- Product Marketing: Positioning, messaging frameworks, ICP segmentation matrix, competitive intelligence, feature launch decks, sales battlecards.
- Demand Generation: Inbound capture, outbound cadences, account lists, lead magnet playbooks, pipeline tracking.
- Content & LinkedIn: Topic clusters, pillar content, thought leadership carousels, executive soundbites, case studies.
- Websites & SEO: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, technical SEO, semantic HTML, schema markup, Core Web Vitals optimization.
- AI-Led Execution: Claude, Cursor, HeyGen AI avatars, prompt workflows, automated research, data synthesis.

## Shipped Work Highlights
- AIQoD Enterprise Site: 42 pages built in Next.js/Tailwind, launched in 5 weeks, supporting enterprise sales cycles.
- VentureHub360 Ecosystem: Multi-product platform marketing, investor scoring workflows, and product launch assets.
- Topic Clusters & Organic Search: Pillar guides and topic clusters with FAQ schema and HTML tables for AI and search visibility.
- Thought Leadership & Video: Executive podcast marketing reels created using Claude, HeyGen avatar explainers, and interactive demos.
